g.text: Daedalus Solution Architecture · Closed-loop defect resolution from Issue to merge-ready patch
Skills (business + tool-type capabilities) → MCP / git → Data layer & external sources (databases via MCP, GitHub currently via git direct connection) ｜ Right side: AgentLoop full-link monitoring
Daedalus Agent Team · Agent team (AgentTeams orchestration, isolated in Docker containers)
Each step generates an execution trace (auditable / replayable) → AgentLoop
Skills · Capability layer (business orchestration + tool-type skills, ZIP + SemVer versioning)
MCP · Model Context Protocol —— Unified tool invocation protocol (data primitive layer)
Data layer & external sources · Databases / storage / external code source
DB accessed uniformly via MCP; GitHub currently via git direct connection (pragmatic exception, switchable to MCP connector)
Human confirms merge · progressive delivery reserved
Full-link observability · part of the framework
Trace metrics and alerts flow in from each layer of the framework
